reviewFollowup.scope: Five PR #883 review findings and failing validation; remaining API parity stays deferred
findings: Cancellation requires ADMIN, execution ownership or owning service-team membership; attached incident visibility also applies. Real PostgreSQL tests cover cross-user, cross-team and cross-service denials with no state, audit or queue changes.
Draft edit/publication require concrete strong revision ETags before replay and under lock; wildcard, missing and stale validators are covered.
Operational-only REST watcher writes are explicitly documented and tested for ordinary-user self-follow denial; eligible UI self-follow remains unchanged.
Privileged draft reads return a safe editable body; revision-bound key-based preservation retains hidden configurations and defaults across structural edits.
Credential migration checklist and real replacement-token tests preserve ordinary administrator behavior while requiring explicit runbook scopes and role capabilities.
reviewFollowup.raceRegression: Binding creation, updates and activation use serializable retries alongside archive. A deterministic PostgreSQL lock gate starts the archive snapshot before binding insertion and verifies the committed binding ends disabled.
